in_hebrew.name: Blight
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Woe, affliction, calamity
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Blight הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word βλαστος (blastos), meaning 'woe' or 'affliction'. In the Christian tradition, Blight is a symbol of suffering and calamity, reminding us of the trials and tribulations we may face in life. The name also carries a spiritual meaning, signifying a call to embrace hardship and find strength in adversity.
